messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English involving two adult friends dealing with a small physical problem together. Keep the action clear and easy to follow. Use concise movement, realistic dialogue, and practical reactions. Do not make the event more dramatic than it is.

The grocery bag split before they reached the car.

“Got it.”

Jordan dropped into a crouch as the oranges rolled across the parking lot.

Alex grabbed the bag handles. “There's another one.”

“I see it.”

She caught the last orange with her foot before it reached the curb.

“Nice.”

“I meant to do that.”

“Obviously.”

Jordan gathered the fruit and looked at the torn bag.

“We need another one.”

Alex opened the trunk. “There's a spare tote in here.”

“Of course there is.”

“You mock me now, but one day you'll thank me.”

Jordan took the tote. “Today is that day.”

Alex handed her the last orange.

“Thanks.”

“Anything else trying to escape?”

Jordan checked the parking lot. “Nope.”

“Good.”

They loaded everything into the tote, closed the trunk, and started toward the store entrance.

Jordan held up the torn bag. “This is embarrassing.”

Alex nodded. “It's a bag. You'll recover.”

“Emotionally?”

“Eventually.”

Jordan laughed. “Good. I was worried.”
